key.name: open
key.summary: Open or close the search box
key.description: Search apps, files, settings and everything else GNOME searches, from a box near the top of the screen, without going to the overview.

key.name: answers
key.description: Answers sums and conversions as they are typed, in the numbers of the session's language.

key.name: times
key.description: Answers "time in Tokyo" and "15:00 Paris in Tokyo" as they are typed, from the places and time zones on this computer.

key.name: reminders
key.description: "remind me at 17:00 to call the garage" becomes a task in Notes' inbox with a reminder, with Enter.

key.name: settings
key.description: Finds Control's settings, and changes one with Enter.

key.name: manual
key.description: Finds the pages of the manual that answer what was typed.

key.name: windows
key.description: Finds an open window by its title, on any workspace.

key.name: clipboard
key.description: Shows what was copied when clip: is typed first, and only then.

key.name: agent
key.description: The last row asks the AI agent, while the agentic features are on.

key.name: glance
key.description: Space shows a file found by the search without opening it.

key.name: bookmarks
key.description: Firefox's bookmarks, never its history, read from a copy of its bookmarks file when a search starts. Off as the image ships.

key.name: notes
key.description: The titles of notes and tasks in Amethystora Notes, asked only while Notes is open and unlocked. Off as the image ships.

key.name: meaning
key.description: Files in Documents found by what they are about, from the text GNOME's indexer extracted, with the agent's small embedding model, on this computer. `ame desktop search meaning` also starts and stops its daily reading. Off as the image ships.
